title: Studio 204 w/ RoofTop View
description:
An amazing Loft close to everything downtown. New stylish furnishing throughout in this roomy space. The building has a great rooftop social space and view of downtown. Perfect affordable spot to stay while visiting Nashville, either for work or play!

The space
Bliss Road Offers 5 Star Properties, Fully Furnished with all Amenities, High End Towels/Linens/ & Bedding.

Nested in a quiet neighborhood with plenty of private parking right outside your door. Quick trip to Downtown Nashville & surrounding tourist spots! Newly remodeled with all the amenities.

Every home has a starter kit stocked with paper products, including paper towels & toilet paper, as well as coffee supplies!

Guest access
The whole house is available for your relaxing pleasure whether inside or out. Enjoy various spaces through-out, for much needed peace & quiet. Keys will be provided for entry.

Guests can enjoy whole house & it is reserved for paid overnight guests only.

Other things to note
The property is designed to be a retreat & peaceful place for a much needed reboot, catching up on a good book, or taking long naps day or evening. Perfect for Nashville Games & Activities or a visiting Doctor/Nurse needing a home away from home. The property is limited to 2 guests only with a strict no party policy. Only registered guests are allowed on property.

NOTE: Weekly lawn care & maintenance is performed on property. All sidewalks & decks are blown off weekly & may occur during your stay.

Special Pricing FOR: Temp Housing Agencies, Insurance Claims, & Corporate Placement Needs.
